analysis_result.analysis: The model’s reasoning failed at the perception stage by misidentifying the colors on the reference cube’s visible faces. This perceptual error cascaded into flawed logic — assuming yellow must be absent because it’s not in the options — and ultimately led to selecting the wrong option (A instead of D). The model’s grounding also failed, as it did not correctly map the observed attributes to the matching option.
